title: Ukrainian Kulich Cake
description: A traditional Ukrainian sweet bread, made with love and a touch of honey.
instructions: Crumb the store-bought or homemade kulich into a bowl.
Mix in the honey, jelly, and like until well combined.
Add the cake crumbs and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Shape the dough into a round loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool completely before slicing and serving.
